name: wx-vsce-cloudflare-ai-models
description: Registers Cloudflare Workers AI / AI Gateway models as VS Code chat language models, so GitHub Copilot Chat and any other LM-aware extension can call them. Streams chat completions over the OpenAI-compatible API with tool calling, ships a guided setup preset for curated models (DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.3, Kimi K2.6/K2.7, Qwen3) plus any custom model id, keeps the API key in SecretStorage, and supports per-model URL and header overrides within your Cloudflare account.

wxCloudflareAi.url.markdownDescription:
Cloudflare AI Gateway endpoint URL.

- AI Gateway (recommended): `https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/<ACCOUNT_ID>/<GATEWAY_ID>/compat`
- Workers AI direct: `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/ai/v1`

Only these two Cloudflare hosts are accepted, over https: the API token is never sent anywhere else. User settings only, so a workspace cannot redirect it.

If the URL ends in `/v\d+` (e.g. `/v1`, `/v2`), `/chat/completions` is appended. If the URL already contains `/chat/completions` or `/responses`, it is used as-is.

wxCloudflareAi.requestHeaders.markdownDescription: Additional HTTP headers to include with every request. Per-model `requestHeaders` override these. `Authorization` and `Content-Type` are always managed by the extension and cannot be overridden.

wxCloudflareAi.models.markdownDescription: Extra models served by the configured endpoint. Optional: the curated Cloudflare presets are always offered once `wxCloudflareAi.url` is set — use this to add other model ids, or to override a preset's metadata by repeating its id. The API key is stored in VS Code's SecretStorage — set it with the `Cloudflare AI: Set API Key` command.

id.description: Model identifier sent in the request body, e.g. "@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k3".

name.description: Display name shown in the model picker. Defaults to id.

url.description: Per-model base URL override. If unset, the top-level url is used.

requestHeaders.description: Per-model HTTP headers, merged on top of wxCloudflareAi.requestHeaders.
